summary: Simulate the one-dimensional Fisher equation on a finite interval with a declared zero-flux stencil and conservative explicit-step positivity guard, as an idealized historical model rather than a forecast.
objective: Simulate the one-dimensional Fisher equation on a finite interval with a declared zero-flux stencil and conservative explicit-step positivity guard, as an idealized historical model rather than a forecast.
example_prompts: Build bounded fisher reaction-diffusion front with explicit units, frames, time and unavailable-data states.

entities.name: One-dimensional habitat
entities.guidance: Use x in [0,L], u in [0,1], diffusion D>0, growth r>=0 and zero-flux endpoints implemented by mirrored ghost values.

entities.name: Field ribbon
entities.guidance: Show u(x,t), diffusion curvature and reaction r*u*(1-u) in linked strips.

entities.name: Front markers
entities.guidance: Threshold locations are derived readouts with grid/time resolution displayed, not organism particles.

state_contract.model: Solve u_t=D*u_xx+r*u*(1-u) on a finite interval of length L>0 with an integer N>=3 uniform nodes, dx=L/(N-1), finite D>0, r>=0 and 0<=u0<=1. Use the centered second difference and forward Euler. Let lambda=D*dt/dx^2 and a=r*dt; accept only finite dt>0, lambda>=0, a>=0 and 2*lambda+a<=1, an authored sufficient bound for this update to preserve [0,1] in exact arithmetic. Enforce zero-flux endpoints with mirrored ghost values u[-1]=u[1] and u[N]=u[N-2]. Store only finite accepted states and fail visibly if roundoff exceeds a declared [0,1] tolerance.
state_contract.authority: Finite L/N/D/r/dt, the stored field u, mirrored-ghost boundary rule and accepted-step ledger own the model. Blender/glTF contains only a static habitat rail/ticks/glyph prototypes; Three.js allocates N values, updates the stencil, derives front readouts and restores the exact initial array.

invariants: No state is accepted when stability guards fail.
Endpoint updates use the declared mirrored-ghost zero-flux stencil; no periodic branch is silently substituted.
u remains in [0,1] within tolerance or run fails visibly.
Particle decorations never drive or validate the field.
motion_guidance: Playback follows stored model/data time; reverse scrub is history and display interpolation never changes the numeric model.
creative_affordances: Use scale-separated context, glyphs and trails while disclosing exaggeration and keeping uncertainty visible.
known_limits: This is Fisher's historical simplest one-dimensional frequency model, presented for equation study rather than endorsement, policy, empirical ecology or population forecast. The finite domain, zero-flux boundary and explicit solver are authored choices.
No numerical simulation, convergence study, render or runtime validation was performed.

claims.statement: Fisher’s 1937 paper models a frequency p on a one-dimensional habitat by partial p/partial t = k partial-squared p/partial x-squared + m p q with q=1-p, under explicitly simplified uniform diffusion and selection assumptions.
claims.scope: Fisher’s simplest idealized advantageous-gene model; this recipe’s finite domain, boundary conditions and solver are authored numerical choices and not ecological forecast validation.

source_refs.locator: Section I, equation (1) and surrounding simplest-conditions discussion

object_craft.structure: Blender authors a unit-length habitat rail, endpoint caps, grid-tick and field-column glyph prototypes; glTF exports static named display assets with no baked solution front.
object_craft.material: Field level and reaction/diffusion terms use height/pattern plus hue.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js scales the rail by L, instantiates N samples, owns the mirrored-ghost stencil and positivity gate, updates height/material buffers from stored u, derives threshold readouts and resets the exact u0 array.

physical_contract.scope: Idealized finite-difference Fisher equation; no individual agents or real forecast.
physical_contract.timestep: Fixed dt with lambda=D*dt/dx^2, a=r*dt and authored sufficient positivity guard 2*lambda+a<=1.
checks: As a separate zero-diffusion analytic unit fixture outside accepted D>0 inputs, compare one cell with the logistic update.
r=0 diffusion-smoothing fixture with zero-flux endpoints.
Reject a step when 2*lambda+a>1 or arithmetic becomes nonfinite.
